subject: revenuesystem.ui_hardening.contract
summary: RevenueSystem UI must minimize wasted title-bar space, prevent overlapping text, show popup fields without unnecessary sidebars/scrolling where feasible, keep window controls top-right, and preserve reliable keyboard navigation.

details.popup_goal: show all important fields without sidebars when feasible
details.implementation_status: historical hardening requirement; current repository must be audited before claiming complete

source.ref: historical owner UI hardening and keyboard requirements
